ux_studio:
Use case: illustration-story. Create one complete landscape 16:9 anime scene for a UX Designer career game. All characters, furniture, floor, shadows and architecture are painted together in a single opaque illustration. No sprites, cutouts, split panels, UI or text.
References: Image 1 defines the economical Japanese anime drawing of people ONLY; do not copy the architect's identity, outfit or hairstyle. Image 2 defines background painting quality, depth and soft window light ONLY.
Scene UX-STUDIO-01: first project briefing at fictional Northline Studio, late morning neutral daylight. A beautiful expensive working design studio: well-proportioned tall windows LEFT, fixed view of a tree-lined canal, three pale rectangular buildings across it, walnut fitted cabinetry on RIGHT, pale honed stone, muted navy chairs, a couple of plants. One restrained desk with one monitor showing only simple blank wireframe rectangles, one closed notebook. No gibberish dashboards.
Canonical people: Asha, 32-year-old Indian woman, warm medium-brown skin, dark brown almond anime eyes, oval face with gently pointed chin, black centre-parted hair in ONE smooth low bun, no fringe, muted teal collarless overshirt over ivory top and charcoal trousers, small gold stud earrings. She is the mentor, standing just in front of the desk, head upright, face around x50% y25%, one open hand showing a thin notebook at chest height. Noah, 25-year-old Mexican man, light olive skin, grey-green narrower anime eyes, longer angular face, short chestnut hair in FOUR broad clumps, pale slate blue rolled-sleeve shirt, navy trousers, no beard or glasses. He stands half a step behind and close to Asha at x65%, listening with one hand on his own chin. Distinct natural head angles, expressions and builds. Both convincingly adult.
STYLE STRICT: flat Japanese 2D television anime people, thin controlled dark-brown contour, small nose mark, short line mouth, flat base skin colour and ONE broad hard-edged cel shadow. Large filled hair masses, only 3-5 interior hair strokes, at most one small flat highlight. Sparse clothing folds. No cheek planes, painted lips, glossy skin, hair strands, crosshatching, thick comic contours, airbrush portrait, 3D or over-rendering. Background richer than people, with broad readable architecture and restrained texture, cool shadows and clear depth. Warm rim only where the LEFT window actually lights them. Faint broad soft sun shafts near windows only; clear air elsewhere, no fog or glitter.
FRAMING: eye-level three-quarter room view, people visible to at least knee level with continuous anatomically complete bodies and unobstructed lower silhouettes. No waist cutoffs, no body emerging from a counter, no desk crossing a torso. Desk BEHIND the people. People and props inside central 40% of the frame to survive portrait crop; faces below top 10% HUD, all meaningful gestures above y55%. Quiet bottom quarter for game dialogue but finish the entire image because the interface will not always cover it. Do not paint an interface, dialogue box, border, watermark, labels or logos.
ux_research:
Use case: illustration-story. One complete opaque 16:9 cinematic Japanese 2D anime illustration for a UX Designer game. Reference Image 1 is the approved complete STUDIO scene: match its anime drawing treatment and the exact identity and outfit of Asha only. Make a DIFFERENT location, not a recreation of the studio.
Scene UX-RESEARCH-01: a calm moderated usability session at Northline Studio, late morning neutral daylight. A dedicated expensive small research room with pale acoustic wall panels, walnut lower cabinets, a single glazed window LEFT looking onto an enclosed courtyard with ONE olive tree and a pale wall; this room does NOT have the studio's canal view. One small round pale oak table, one laptop with a blank wireframe, two refined navy chairs, no clutter or fake text.
Asha is the SAME Indian mentor from Image 1: warm medium-brown skin, dark brown almond eyes, gently pointed oval chin, black SIDE part and low bun as actually drawn in the reference, teal overshirt with ivory top, charcoal trousers, tiny gold studs. She sits at left-centre x43% taking a sparse note on paper, watching quietly without pointing to the answer. Participant Eleanor, 58-year-old White woman, fair skin, green eyes, broad mature face, small hooded anime eyes, grey chin-length blunt bob made from a few solid shapes, dark plum cardigan and pale blue shirt. She sits at right-centre x61%, one hand resting naturally at the laptop trackpad, thoughtful expression looking at laptop. Two adult people, different face shapes and head angles, plausible seated anatomy, complete bodies behind a believable table and chairs. Table is a genuine physical occluder, not a pasted-on waist cutoff. Finish all visible limbs, chair joints, desk edges and floor; it must look complete without a dialogue box.
Flat anime people: thin controlled outlines, small nose mark, short line mouth, one broad hard-edged cel shadow, mostly flat base colours. Hair in large smooth masses with very few lines. No painted lips, realistic skin, hair strands, glossy shine, hatching, western comic cheek planes, 3D or dense gradients. Keep the painterly architectural depth of the reference, restrained material texture and calm blue/neutral daylight, shared LEFT light direction on furniture and people. Soft faint light shafts only close to the courtyard window, not fog across faces.
Eye-level medium-wide room view. Both faces clustered within central 35% of frame, at y25-35%, important hands and laptop above y55%, quiet but fully finished bottom quarter for native game UI. Do not generate an interface, captions, names, labels, logos or watermarks.
ux_review:
Use case: illustration-story. Create one complete opaque 16:9 Japanese anime career-game scene, UX-REVIEW-01. Reference Image 1 is the canonical studio scene for Asha's exact identity, anime drawing style and workplace material family. Reference Image 2 is the approved character drawing style only.
A DIFFERENT room at Northline Studio: a quiet expensive design review room, one pale stone oval table in the midground RIGHT, one wall screen with only three blank wireframe rectangles and no writing, walnut wall panels, muted navy chairs, a tall single window LEFT looking onto a lower roof garden with ornamental grasses and a pale city block beyond. The review room must have its own fixed outside view; do not transplant the canal or courtyard.
Main figure Samira, 46-year-old Black woman, deep brown skin, amber-brown narrow almond anime eyes, broad mature face with soft square jaw and heavier upper eyelids, charcoal black hair in ONE smooth compact close-cropped silhouette with a grey temple accent, dark aubergine tailored trouser suit over a cream high-neck shirt, small brushed gold hoops, upright shoulders and level chin. She stands x50%, facing the player three-quarter, holding a closed thin tablet at lower chest and making a small measured open-hand gesture, a calm serious expression. Asha from canonical studio Image 1 stands half a step behind at x64%, attentive with hands relaxed: same black side part and low bun, same face shape, eye colour, warm medium-brown skin, teal overshirt, ivory top, charcoal trousers and small studs. Do not give them the same face or hair.
Keep people flat economical 2D television anime: thin controlled contours, small nose mark, short line mouth, flat skin base and ONE broad cel shadow. No cheek carving, realistic lips, shine bands, hair strands, crosshatching, thick western comic ink or 3D. Samira must read as middle-aged through broader jaw, smaller eyes and bearing, not teenager with grey hair. Keep hair extremely simple. Use only necessary garment folds.
Both people visible to knees with anatomically continuous lower bodies; no waist cutoff, no counter in front of them, no fake lower-body concealment. Furniture BEHIND people. One coherent afternoon daylight source from LEFT with neutral blue sky, soft warm edge and cool unlit areas. Faint soft rays only close to window; rich painted room depth with restrained texture, no glitter, fog or dense generated objects.
Faces y20-32%, clustered central 35% for portrait crop; hands and tablet above y55%. Finish quiet bottom quarter so nothing looks incomplete when game dialogue is absent. No game UI, text, logos, borders, contact sheet or watermark.
ux_reaction: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this complete UX-STUDIO-01 image. ONLY change Asha's mouth (the woman at the left-centre of the image) from an open smile to a small calm closed-mouth smile. This is a dialogue reaction candidate, not a new scene. Preserve her exact face shape, eye shape/colour, skin, hair, clothes, hand, notebook and body. Preserve Noah entirely. Keep every pixel outside the woman's mouth region unchanged, including room, windows, exterior buildings, canal, trees, lighting, furniture, composition, resolution and crop. Do not redraw the picture, change time of day or add detail. Keep the flat anime line-and-cel drawing. Deliver one complete opaque landscape image, no UI.
